title: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: This is a routine SEC 8-K filing from Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. announcing that the Hart-Scott-Rodino (HSR) antitrust waiting period for their proposed merger with Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. has expired. This satisfies one of several conditions for the deal's completion; other conditions remain. This is a company-specific M&A disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
